name: Red Dragon Guppy
description: The Red Dragon Guppy is one of our most popular home-bred varieties, known for its bold red-orange tail and calm temperament. Raised in carefully maintained tanks with stable water parameters, these guppies adapt well to most community aquariums and are a great choice for both beginners and experienced keepers.
shortDescription: Bold red-orange tail, calm and hardy, great for community tanks.

name: Blue Moscow Guppy
description: Blue Moscow Guppies display a rich, solid metallic blue body that catches the light beautifully in a well-lit tank. This is a limited batch from our current breeding cycle, home-raised with a focus on strong coloration and healthy fins.
shortDescription: Rich metallic blue body, limited batch from this breeding cycle.

name: Yellow Cobra Guppy
description: The Yellow Cobra Guppy features a striking snakeskin pattern across a bright yellow base. Home-bred and raised on a varied diet for strong color development, these are a favorite among hobbyists who want a standout centerpiece fish in a planted tank.
shortDescription: Bright yellow snakeskin pattern, a favorite centerpiece fish.
